description: No schedule is set here on purpose. Renovate's schedule controls when it is allowed
to create branches, not when it runs. Since this is self-hosted, the cron in
.github/workflows/renovate.yml already decides that, and a second gate only blocks

packageRules.description: pip_requirements also claims the .txt files by default — managerFilePatterns adds to the built-in patterns, it does not replace them. There it sees a compiled lock as a list of plain pins and will happily bump a transitive one past what its parent allows.
Transitive pins are dictated by their parent. Refresh them through lockFileMaintenance, never individually.
Keep the base image digest current, so pinning it does not mean never patching it
One pull request for all workflow action bumps instead of one per action
One pull request for the Python dependency set
